title: Tirumurugan
desc: The son of a billionaire decides to leave his luxurious life behind by switching lives with his lookalike, who is a corporate employee, to experience the lifestyle that they both want to live.

title: Gandhi Kannadi
desc: An event organizer orchestrates a grand diamond jubilee for an elderly gentleman. This profound assignment facilitates an unexpected journey involving sentimental aspirations and sincere bonds.

title: Amaran
desc: Major Mukund Varadarajan, a commissioned officer in the Rajput Regiment of the Indian Army, conducts a counterterrorism operation while being deployed to Jammu and Kashmir.

title: Hit List
desc: Charlotte maintains a journal in which she writes names of people she wished were dead. When she finds a soulmate in Lyle, he starts killing the people on the list to prove his love to her.

title: Daaku Maharaaj
desc: A brave thief fights to survive and claim his territory. However, he battles powerful enemies, aiming to become a leader without a real kingdom.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
desc: Rocky, a young man, seeks power and wealth in order to fulfil a promise to his dying mother. His quest takes him to Mumbai, where he gets involved with the notorious gold mafia.

title: Bhimaa
desc: After some mysterious instances at a temple of historical significance, a detective visits the region to investigate and find out the truth behind the incidents.

title: Meagamann
desc: Chitti works for Jothi, a powerful drug lord, and is busy expanding his business and criminal activities. Unfortunately, his trusted assistant, Shiva, has other plans for him.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Maanidan
desc: A charming flirt who has never been in a serious relationship with anyone finds himself in unfamiliar territory when he finally falls in love with a woman.

title: Silukkuvarpatti Singam
desc: Police constable Shakthi prefers a laid back approach to his job and tries to actively stay away from danger. But he is forced to change this attitude when he inadvertently jails a wanted don.

title: Gangers
desc: Saravanan, an undercover officer disguised as a PT master, confronts merciless criminals, unearths their fraud and recruits school personnel to dismantle their operation.

title: Kondraal Paavam
desc: The life of a poverty-stricken family becomes more complicated after an unanticipated visitor who goes by the name Arjunan, enters their household.

title: Maharaja
desc: Prince Kohinoor returns home after twenty years only to discover that Ranbir Singh, his parents' killer, still holds control. Subsequently, he decides to defeat him to protect his loved ones.

title: Ithu Thaanda Police
desc: Ramakrishna, a police constable, is posted as a driver at Elathur Women's police station. His life becomes challenging as he has to deal with the fiery sub-inspector Arundhati Varma to save his job.
